events.name: player_death
events.comment: a game event, name may be 32 charaters long

annotations.description: Fired when a player dies.  Carries `userid` (the victim) and `attacker`.  Detailed kill information (weapon, headshot, assister, penetration count, no-scope flag, distance) lives on the legacy `cs_gameevents.proto` user-message `CMsgSource1LegacyGameEvent` payload — extract those keys when parsing demos.
Fired when a round concludes.  Carries the winning team (`winner`), the reason for the win (`reason`, see RoundEndReason table below), and a human-readable `message` string.
annotations.notes: The `winner` value uses the same team-number scheme as the `Team` constant in `well_known_constants.json` (2=T, 3=CT, 0/1 for draw / unassigned).  The `reason` byte enumerates win conditions: bomb detonation, defusal, time expiry, eliminations, surrender, etc. — full mapping is in `public/cstrike15_gameconstants.h` upstream.

annotations.description: Fired when a round concludes.  Carries the winning team (`winner`), the reason for the win (`reason`, see RoundEndReason table below), and a human-readable `message` string.
annotations.notes: The `winner` value uses the same team-number scheme as the `Team` constant in `well_known_constants.json` (2=T, 3=CT, 0/1 for draw / unassigned).  The `reason` byte enumerates win conditions: bomb detonation, defusal, time expiry, eliminations, surrender, etc. — full mapping is in `public/cstrike15_gameconstants.h` upstream.

annotations.description: Fired when the C4 is successfully armed.  `site` is the bombsite index (0=A, 1=B).  At this point a `CPlantedC4` entity exists and the 40-second countdown begins.

fields.name: assister
fields.comment: player who assisted in the kill

fields.name: weapon_itemid
fields.comment: inventory item id of weapon killer used

fields.name: weapon_fauxitemid
fields.comment: faux item id of weapon killer used

fields.name: dominated
fields.comment: did killer dominate victim with this kill

fields.name: revenge
fields.comment: did killer get revenge on victim with this kill

fields.name: wipe
fields.comment: is the kill resulting in squad wipe

fields.name: penetrated
fields.comment: number of objects shot penetrated before killing target

fields.name: noreplay
fields.comment: if replay data is unavailable, this will be present and set to false

fields.name: noscope
fields.comment: kill happened without a scope, used for death notice icon

fields.name: thrusmoke
fields.comment: hitscan weapon went through smoke grenade

annotations.description: Fired each time a player pulls the trigger and a shot is taken. `weapon` is the lowercase classname (`ak47`, `awp`, `knife`, `hegrenade`, …).  Use `bullet_damage` for the *hit* event counterpart.
